title: See the signals. Understand the limits.
subtitle: Explore the research behind OptiFlow, the experience we are building, and how we plan to test it.
proposition: OptiFlow is designed to turn a webcam check-in into understandable signals, personal reflection, and a practical next step—with evidence you can inspect.

proposed_signature_feature.name: Pulse Portrait
proposed_signature_feature.description: An optional camera-derived pulse estimate, revealed as a waveform and a quiet ambient halo.
proposed_signature_feature.note: Remote photoplethysmography is established research; the OptiFlow experience and validation workflow are our proposed contribution.

pillars.title: Observe
pillars.body: Measure visible events and, when validated, recover a pulse-related signal from video.

pillars.title: Explain
pillars.body: Separate measured observations, user responses, and model estimates. Show where each result came from.

pillars.title: Reflect
pillars.body: Invite the user to confirm how they feel and compare compatible check-ins over time.

pillars.title: Reset
pillars.body: Offer a small activity and collect feedback about whether it helped.

evidence_statuses.label: Used for training
evidence_statuses.requires: Dataset permission, manifest, and training run

methodology: Define a specific target and original label scale.
Measure events and compare them with authorized annotations.
Collect genuine self-reports separately from predictions.
Split participants and recordings before creating windows.
Compare simple and advanced models on untouched data.
Test browser parity, rejection behavior, and device conditions.
Publish limitations and measured results as they become available.

validation.status: No OptiFlow model validation supplied in this kit
validation.synthetic_checks: Passed the supplied reference checker; not human measurement validation

privacy.body: Process frames locally by default, retain summaries only by choice, stop capture on exit, and offer export/delete. Verify network behavior before claiming these requirements are implemented.

attribution: OptiFlow builds on the credited researchers and open-source contributors. Inclusion does not imply their endorsement.
